# Sea Runner — Private Boat Tours from La Spezia (Cinque Terre, Portovenere, Portofino)

> Sea Runner is a family-run company offering private boat tours on the Italian Riviera, departing from La Spezia (Porto Mirabello marina). Captain Marco and Paola host one group at a time, up to 8 guests, aboard a 9-metre Jeanneau Cap Camarat 9.0 WA. Tours are never shared: the price is for the whole boat, with skipper and fuel included.

## Key facts
- Type: private boat tours with skipper (never shared with other groups)
- Base: Porto Mirabello, La Spezia, Liguria, Italy (free parking for 2 cars). Pickup on request at the La Spezia cruise terminal area, Portovenere or Lerici
- Guests: up to 8 per tour
- Languages on board: English, Italian, French
- Always included: skipper, hostess, fuel, snorkeling gear, towels, drinks on board (water, soft drinks, beer, local wines, Prosecco)
- Full-day tours: lunch on board included. Half-day and sunset tours: aperitif on board
- Times are indicative and agreed with each guest; cruise passengers are brought back to port well before departure
- Season: spring to autumn (March to November)
- Booking: request a free quote at https://searunner.it/booking (reply within 24 hours, no payment required to request a quote)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +39 348 828 9438
- Email: searunnerprenotazioni@gmail.com
- Reviews: Google Maps (Sea Runner 5 Terre Boat Tours), Tripadvisor, Viator, GetYourGuide

## Tours
- [Cinque Terre full day](https://searunner.it/booking/cinque-terre): all five villages from the sea, swimming stops, lunch on board, possibility to go ashore in Vernazza or Monterosso
- [Portofino](https://searunner.it/booking/portofino): long day along the Riviera to Portofino, with a stop to visit the village
- [Gulf of Poets](https://searunner.it/booking/golfo-dei-poeti): Portovenere and the Palmaria, Tino and Tinetto islands
- [Half day](https://searunner.it/booking/half-day): 4 hours, morning, afternoon or evening slot
- [Sunset](https://searunner.it/booking/sunset): about 3.5 hours at sunset with aperitif on board
- [Tailored tour](https://searunner.it/booking/tailored): custom itinerary agreed with the guests
